name: Clyde Nefoti
professional_title: Bachelor of Information Systems | IT and Data Management
introduction: Database design, information management, systems analysis, and end-user support. Final-year studies completed; awaiting graduation.
biography:
Completed final-year Bachelor of Information Systems studies at Divine Word University, Papua New Guinea, with knowledge of database design, information management and systems analysis.

Developed and deployed TeleHealth PNG, a web-based teleconsultation and appointment management system for the Milne Bay Provincial Health Authority, using MySQL, role-based access control and secure information handling practices.

Practical experience with Active Directory and end-user technical support.

Professional interests include supporting medical and public health research through information technology.

Clyde Nefoti is from Milne Bay and Enga Provinces. A system should be clear to use, carefully documented, and ready for the people it is meant to serve.
